key.name: show-status-in-panel
key.summary: Show the machine name in the panel
key.description: When off, the panel shows only the Tailscale icon.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to turn Tailscale on and off
key.description: Empty by default, so it cannot collide with a binding you already use.

key.name: active-provider
key.summary: Which VPN provider the panel drives
key.description: Empty picks the first installed provider TailGauge can drive.

key.name: recent-mullvad-regions
key.summary: Recently used Mullvad exit node regions
key.description: Keeps the exit node list a shortlist rather than the whole Mullvad fleet.
